hint.association: Membership fees are usually outside corporate tax; the annual corporate tax return is form 200.

hint.corporate_partially_exempt: For associations: only economic activity is taxed, members’ fees are not.
hint.corporate: All of the entity’s profit is taxed.
hint.irpf_direct_simplified: Income minus expenses; turnover up to €600,000 a year.
hint.irpf_direct_normal: Income minus expenses with full bookkeeping; required above €600,000 turnover.
hint.irpf_objective: Tax based on business indicators such as floor space and staff, not on profit.

hint.general: VAT on sales minus VAT on purchases: quarterly form 303 and annual form 390.
hint.exempt: The activity is VAT exempt (art. 20 LIVA): no VAT is charged or deducted.
hint.equivalence_surcharge: Retail by an autónomo: the supplier charges the surcharge and no form 303 is filed for this activity.

directionHelp.income: Income — money came into the club: member fees, sales, grants. The category decides where it shows in reports and which tax applies by default.
directionHelp.expense: Expense — money left the club: rent, purchases, services, salaries. Keep the receipt or invoice — the gestor will ask for it for the expense book.
directionHelp.transfer: Transfer — money moves between your own accounts, e.g. cash takings paid into the bank. It is neither income nor expense and carries no tax.

hints.category: The category groups operations in reports (rent, purchases, fees) and suggests the default tax. Categories are set up in the finance settings.
hints.account: Where the money is: cash — notes and coins, bank — the club's bank account, card — card payments or the terminal.
hints.includesTax: A receipt usually shows the total including IVA — keep “Amount includes tax”. An invoice lists the base and IVA separately: you can enter the base and switch it off.
hints.taxRate: IVA is the Spanish value-added tax. The default rate comes from the category. The general rate in Spain is 21 %, the reduced ones are 10 % and 4 %.
hints.withholding: IRPF withholding applies when you pay a professional (gestor, lawyer, autónomo): the club pays them the amount minus the withholding and pays the withheld part to Hacienda itself (form 111). Usually 15 %, 7 % for new autónomos. If you are not paying a professional, leave 0.
hints.counterparty: Who you pay or receive money from. The list is on the “Counterparties” tab. For a member fee, pick the member in the field next to it.
hints.document: Number and date of the receipt or invoice. For expenses they go into the invoice book you hand to the gestor.
hints.paidOn: Fill it in when the money moved on another day than the operation: e.g. an invoice dated the 1st paid on the 15th.
